headline: PSSI Prepares FFI Extraordinary Congress Amidst Internal Conflict
metaDescription: PSSI schedules an Extraordinary Congress for the Indonesian Futsal Federation as leadership disputes continue to impact the organization's structure.
aiSummaryBullets: PSSI has scheduled an Extraordinary Congress (KLB) for the Indonesian Futsal Federation (FFI) on December 11, 2026.
Acting FFI Chairperson Vivin Cahyani stated that the internal organizational conflict will not disrupt national team preparations or league schedules.
PSSI leadership explained that former FFI Chairperson Michael Sianipar was not summoned for clarification due to his two-year absence and lack of communication.
aiContextParagraph: The Indonesian Futsal Federation (FFI) is currently experiencing internal instability marked by a leadership change initiated by the Football Association of Indonesia (PSSI). Following the dismissal of former FFI Chairperson Michael Sianipar, PSSI has appointed an acting chairperson to oversee the organization's operations. The conflict escalated as PSSI prepares for an Extraordinary Congress, or Kongres Luar Biasa (KLB), which is set to take place on December 11, 2026, to address ongoing governance issues. Despite these administrative developments, FFI leadership has emphasized that the ongoing disputes will not hinder the schedules of the national futsal teams or the professional futsal leagues. PSSI officials have publicly stated that the decision not to involve the former chairperson in clarification meetings stems from a prolonged lapse in communication and his extended absence from the federation's active internal processes.
whyItIsViral: The story is being covered by four independent outlets, reflecting significant interest in the administrative stability of the national futsal governing body.
